notes.bari vs real_armor: Bari's piercing arrow ignores Real Armor's block.
notes.bari vs daewi: Bari's piercing arrow reaches Daewi before his slow heavy swing starts.
notes.bari vs sepia: Sepia's fast attacks close the distance faster than Bari's arrow can be fired.
notes.bari vs nightcrow: Nightcrow's fast attacks outpace Bari's arrow at close range.
notes.daewi vs real_armor: Daewi's heavy attack breaks Real Armor's block.
notes.real_armor vs sepia: Real Armor's block beats Sepia's light and fast attacks.
notes.nightcrow vs real_armor: Real Armor's block beats Nightcrow's light and fast attacks.
notes.daewi vs sepia: Sepia's fast attacks beat Daewi's slow swing, but Daewi's heavy hits offset it.
notes.daewi vs nightcrow: Nightcrow's fast attacks beat Daewi's slow heavy swing.
notes.nightcrow vs sepia: Both are fast closers with the same tools.
